evidence_items.explanation: Reuters describes investor concern and corporate defenses of AI spending in the aftermath of DeepSeek. The report also identifies slowing cloud growth, so it cannot isolate DeepSeek's effect or establish resistance specifically to GPU purchases.

Alphabet continued substantial investment and described additional planned spending elsewhere in the transcript. This weighs against interpreting the forecast as a halt to investment, but total CapEx does not measure GPU spending or investor acceptance.
